title: Every English Ballon d'Or Winner 🏆 Harry Kane Ends 25-Year Wait #shorts
description:
Every English Ballon d'Or winner: Stanley Matthews (Blackpool, 1956), Bobby Charlton (Manchester United, 1966), Kevin Keegan (Hamburg, 1978 and 1979), Michael Owen (Liverpool, 2001) and now Harry Kane, who won the 2026 Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium on 26 October after scoring 73 goals for Bayern Munich and England. Kane is the first English winner in 25 years, and Keegan is still the only Englishman to win it twice.

title: Longest Winning Streaks in NBA History: Lakers 33 🤯 Spurs at 10 #shorts
description:
The longest winning streaks in NBA history: the Los Angeles Lakers won 33 straight in 1971–72 (5 Nov 1971 to 9 Jan 1972), the Golden State Warriors won 28 across 2014–15 and 2015–16, the Miami Heat won 27 in 2012–13, the Houston Rockets 22 in 2007–08 and the Milwaukee Bucks 20 in 1970–71. Victor Wembanyama's San Antonio Spurs have won 10 in a row (as of 12 Nov 2026).

title: Cavaliers vs Knicks 115–107: James Harden Season-High 32 🔥 #shorts
description:
